overview:
Josh Gottheimer seeks another term in a northern New Jersey district that leans slightly Democratic. He enters the general election with a decisive financial advantage, holding more than $12.7 million in cash after raising over $4.7 million, while Republican Sean Kirrane has raised under $60,000 with minimal outside support. No independent or major outside spending has been reported against the incumbent.

No public polls or expert race ratings are available for this contest, so the picture rests on fundamentals and market pricing. Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket both put the Democrat's chances above 90%. With the incumbent well-funded and the district's lean favoring his party, this race is rated Safe Democratic, though the absence of polling leaves some uncertainty about the exact margin.
